title: Projected Annual Property Tax of a Summit Reserve — Review Calculation
content:
At each review of the property tax bills of a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, the annual property tax held on file is the projected annual property tax defined here. It spreads the coming twelve months between this tax year's tax and the next tax year's tax.

## Calculation

1. **The tax year's bills** are the property tax bills on file for the reserve received within the twelve months before the review: received no later than the review date and fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.
2. **The tax year's tax** is the sum of the billed amounts of the tax year's bills whose status is paid or received; withdrawn bills are left out.
3. **The next tax year's tax** is the tax year's tax increased by the assessment allowance percentage, and then increased by the exemption allowance amount. The assessment allowance is the increase percentage of 2.0 percent; the exemption allowance is zero.
4. **The next-year share** is the whole calendar months from the due date of the paid property tax bill with the latest due date to the review date, divided by twelve, never below zero and never above one.
5. **The projected annual property tax** is the tax year's tax times one less the next-year share, plus the next tax year's tax times the next-year share. It is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end; no intermediate figure is rounded. The review relies on the most recently received property tax bill on file.

## Worked figures on hypothetical inputs

Tax year's bills: two paid installments of 1,500.00 each and one withdrawn bill. Tax year's tax 3,000.00; next tax year's tax 3,000.00 increased by 2.0 percent, 3,060.00, plus a zero exemption allowance.

| Latest-due paid bill fell due | Whole months to the review | Next-year share | Projected annual property tax |
|---|---|---|---|
| 4 whole months before the review | 4 | 4 twelfths | 3,000.00 times 8 twelfths plus 3,060.00 times 4 twelfths: 3,020.00 |
| 15 whole months before the review | 15 | 1 (never above one) | 3,060.00 |
| After the review date | below zero | 0 (never below zero) | 3,000.00 |
